scripts.title: Hydra VIP Script
scripts.features:
!!: PLEASE CHECK THE VIEW RAW BOX BEFORE EXECUTING!

This script was originally in ScriptBlox but has been deleted for some reason. I really liked this script and I luckily found it in a discord server from a YouTube channel listed in the photo. This does not belong to me and is a reupload.

Original creator: HydraX

FEATURES:
Aimbot
Silent Aim - Easily shoot at people without looking at them
Infinite Ammo - Self explanatory
No Recoil - No shaky guns
No Spread - No ammo moving to different directions
Fast Guns - Makes guns shoot very fast
Automatic Guns - Makes guns shoot automatically by holding instead of tapping

It also has a Kill All and ESP feature.

Fun fact: you can also use this script in other games if they use the same guns that are used in Fortline games.
